title: MATRIX_PROFILE_MOTIF_DISCORD_REGIME_ALLOCATOR
information_set: Causal trailing vectors of draw summaries and frozen-strategy residuals
transformation: Matrix profile; motif; discord; FLUSS-style boundary scores
target: Next-draw strategy allocation and optional abstention
temporal_rule: At t use only observations through t-1; refit thresholds inside each training fold
selection_or_gating: Select a fixed strategy family only when the current subsequence has a supported historical analogue; abstain on unsupported discords
canonical_definition: Use a causal matrix profile over predeclared trailing residual and draw-state vectors to identify motifs; discords; and boundaries; then map only previously observed analogue states to a frozen strategy choice or abstention
novelty_basis: New subsequence-similarity transformation and analogue support rule

title: TRANSFER_ENTROPY_DIRECTED_LAG_GRAPH
information_set: Lagged binary number indicators; draw summaries; and frozen-strategy residual streams
transformation: Conditional transfer entropy with surrogate-tested directed edges
target: Per-number residual scores or strategy-family selection
temporal_rule: All embeddings; lags; estimators; and thresholds fit using training history only
selection_or_gating: Activate only edges stable across inner temporal folds; otherwise revert to baseline
canonical_definition: Estimate a causal directed information-flow graph from lagged histories and use only stable conditional transfer-entropy edges as residual features
novelty_basis: Directionality and conditioning are absent from co-occurrence and hypergraph hypotheses

title: RECURRENCE_QUANTIFICATION_STATE_GATE
information_set: Causal rolling draw-state and residual feature vectors
transformation: Delay embedding; recurrence plot; recurrence rate; determinism; laminarity
target: Conditional strategy allocation or abstention
temporal_rule: Embedding dimension; radius; and gate frozen inside training folds
selection_or_gating: Route to a fixed strategy only in recurrence states with training-fold support
canonical_definition: Convert trailing state vectors into recurrence-quantification descriptors and use them as a causal regime gate for fixed strategies
novelty_basis: Recurrence geometry is a new transformation rather than another scalar entropy statistic

title: CONTEXT_TREE_WEIGHTED_SYMBOLIC_RESIDUAL_FORECASTER
information_set: Symbolized causal histories of number indicators; gaps; ranks; or residual signs
transformation: Context-tree weighting and code-length surprise
target: Per-number probability residual or strategy-family score
temporal_rule: Bounded depth selected in inner walk-forward folds; prediction at t uses symbols through t-1
selection_or_gating: Use only when prequential code length improves against fixed-order Markov and uniform baselines
canonical_definition: Apply bounded-depth context-tree weighting to symbolized histories and convert posterior predictive probabilities or excess code length into residual scores
novelty_basis: Universal variable-memory compression is distinct from fixed-order Markov and generic state-space models

title: DENSITY_RATIO_IMPORTANCE_WEIGHTED_RECALIBRATION
information_set: Recent and reference-window covariates plus frozen out-of-fold per-number predictions
transformation: Direct recent-to-reference density-ratio estimation with clipped weights
target: Recalibrated per-number probabilities and strategy ranking
temporal_rule: At each origin estimate weights from covariates available before t; tune clipping in inner folds
selection_or_gating: Enable weighted recalibration only when effective sample size and balance diagnostics pass
canonical_definition: Estimate covariate-shift weights between recent and reference states and use clipped weights for causal probability recalibration; with ESS-based fallback
novelty_basis: Importance-weighted adaptation is a new transformation and safety gate

title: HAWKES_EXCITATION_INHIBITION_RESIDUAL_SCORER
information_set: Event times for each number and predeclared pair groups; optionally frozen-strategy error events
transformation: Regularized multivariate Hawkes intensity with positive and inhibitory effects
target: Next-draw per-number residual intensity or abstention
temporal_rule: Fit only on events before the prediction origin; stability and branching constraints frozen in training
selection_or_gating: Use intensity residuals only when simulated-null and holdout diagnostics reject a memoryless event baseline
canonical_definition: Treat number appearances or strategy errors as marked events and test whether regularized self/cross-excitation adds causal residual ranking information
novelty_basis: Continuous-time event-history mechanism is absent from the 28

title: NVAR_RESERVOIR_CAUSAL_RESIDUAL_META_FEATURE
information_set: Causal lag vectors of draw summaries; per-number states; and frozen-strategy residuals
transformation: Fixed random reservoir or polynomial nonlinear vector autoregression
target: Out-of-fold residual prediction and strategy allocation
temporal_rule: Reservoir and regularization frozen within training folds; no bidirectional context
selection_or_gating: Admit only if a linear autoregressive control is beaten across prespecified horizons
canonical_definition: Use a low-capacity causal reservoir or NVAR to generate nonlinear residual meta-features; then test them against linear and existing neural controls
novelty_basis: New low-compute dynamical transformation; not merely another LSTM or Transformer

title: PERSISTENT_HOMOLOGY_ROLLING_STRUCTURE_GATE
information_set: Delay embeddings or graph filtrations built from trailing draw/residual vectors
transformation: Persistent homology; persistence landscapes or summary norms
target: Regime gate; anomaly flag; or strategy allocation
temporal_rule: Each filtration uses history through t-1; scales and featurization fixed in training folds
selection_or_gating: Activate only topological states with adequate historical support; otherwise abstain
canonical_definition: Compute causal topological summaries of rolling state clouds or structural graphs and test whether they condition residual strategy performance
novelty_basis: Topology of evolving state geometry is not represented in the existing hypotheses

title: STRATEGY_DRAW_METRIC_TENSOR_FACTOR_RESIDUAL_GATE
information_set: Out-of-fold tensor indexed by strategy; draw window; and predeclared metric or number group
transformation: Regularized CP or Tucker factorization with rank selected inside training folds
target: Latent strategy-state compatibility and allocation
temporal_rule: Construct factors only from past out-of-fold cells; update expanding-window
selection_or_gating: Select strategy families whose causal latent factors align with the current state; fallback on unstable ranks
canonical_definition: Factor a strategy-by-time-by-metric residual tensor to expose low-rank interactions unavailable to flat stacking; use factors only for causal allocation
novelty_basis: Joint multiway residual structure is a new representation

title: PERMUTATION_ENTROPY_ORDINAL_STATE_GATE
information_set: Causal trailing sequences of draw summaries and residual statistics
transformation: Ordinal pattern encoding and permutation entropy
target: Regime gate; anomaly flag; or abstention
temporal_rule: Window; order; and thresholds selected within training only
selection_or_gating: Route only when ordinal-complexity bins have supported conditional effects
canonical_definition: Replace or augment generic entropy-shift signals with permutation entropy on ordinal patterns and test conditional allocation
novelty_basis: Specific ordinal-complexity transformation extends H20

title: MMD_JOINT_DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT_ALLOCATOR
information_set: Recent and reference multivariate draw/residual feature windows
transformation: Maximum mean discrepancy with permutation or sequentially calibrated thresholds
target: Strategy allocation; model reset; or abstention
temporal_rule: Reference set and kernel bandwidth chosen without future data; alarms evaluated prequentially
selection_or_gating: On supported joint shift select a predeclared fallback or abstain; never infer which numbers changed from the same test
canonical_definition: Use a causal kernel two-sample statistic to detect joint distribution shifts that scalar entropy tests can miss and trigger a fixed allocation action
novelty_basis: Multivariate kernel shift test extends the H20 anomaly gate

title: WASSERSTEIN_WINDOW_SHIFT_ALLOCATOR
information_set: Ordered recent and reference empirical distributions of draw/residual features
transformation: Regularized Wasserstein or sliced-Wasserstein distance
target: Changepoint alarm; strategy reset; or abstention
temporal_rule: Only backward-looking windows; thresholds fit on earlier null segments
selection_or_gating: Trigger only a prespecified action; use robust scaling and minimum window support
canonical_definition: Compare causal windows with an optimal-transport distance and test whether alarms support a fixed allocation or abstention rule
novelty_basis: Geometry-aware distribution shift extends H19 and H20

title: CONFORMAL_SET_SIZE_COVERAGE_ABSTENTION
information_set: Causal out-of-fold per-number scores and calibration residuals
transformation: Adaptive conformal sets or risk-control calibration
target: Strategy eligibility; candidate-set size; or abstention
temporal_rule: Calibration windows precede each prediction; coverage monitored prequentially
selection_or_gating: Abstain or downweight when the calibrated candidate set exceeds a frozen size or coverage degrades
canonical_definition: Combine calibrated per-number probabilities with uncertainty-set size and empirical coverage to drive a causal reject or allocation rule
novelty_basis: New actionable combination of probability calibration and uncertainty

title: CONTEXT_CONDITIONED_MMD_DRIFT_GATE
information_set: Predeclared causal contexts plus recent/reference residual feature windows
transformation: Context-stratified MMD with multiplicity control
target: Conditional strategy allocation or abstention
temporal_rule: Contexts; kernels; and alpha-spending frozen in training; minimum subgroup support enforced
selection_or_gating: Act only on replicated context-specific shifts; otherwise retain global baseline
canonical_definition: Test joint distribution shift inside predeclared regimes to detect conditional heterogeneity hidden by a global null
novelty_basis: New combination of regime conditioning and multivariate drift

title: CHANGEPOINT_TRIGGERED_META_SELECTION
information_set: Causal changepoint statistics plus frozen-strategy out-of-fold residual histories
transformation: ADWIN; Page-Hinkley; or one prespecified detector followed by local competence estimation
target: Choose among frozen strategy families; reset; or abstain
temporal_rule: Detector and selector fit only on prior residuals; action begins after alarm
selection_or_gating: Require minimum post-alarm support; no retroactive relabeling of the alarm segment
canonical_definition: Use a causal changepoint alarm to change the training horizon or eligible strategy set of a residual meta-selector
novelty_basis: Mechanistically clear combination of H19 with H01/H03

title: CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY_DPP_PORTFOLIO
information_set: Causal calibrated per-number probabilities plus ticket similarity features
transformation: DPP kernel combining ticket quality and diversity
target: Multi-ticket portfolio for M1+; M2+; M3+ or coverage
temporal_rule: Calibration and kernel hyperparameters fit inside training folds; tickets generated after scoring
selection_or_gating: Select a fixed ticket count; compare quality-only and diversity-only controls
canonical_definition: Build a DPP ticket kernel whose quality term is a causally calibrated probability objective and whose similarity term controls overlap
novelty_basis: New testable combination of H07 and H14 rather than a new DPP method

title: STATE_SPACE_POSTERIOR_MULTIWINDOW_DISAGREEMENT
information_set: Causal posterior state estimates and predeclared short/medium/long window predictors
transformation: Posterior predictive disagreement and slope contrast
target: Strategy allocation or abstention
temporal_rule: All windows end at t-1; state model and thresholds refit within training folds
selection_or_gating: Use only disagreement patterns with replicated conditional residual effects
canonical_definition: Combine a Bayesian latent-state posterior with multi-window disagreement to gate a fixed strategy or abstention action
novelty_basis: New combination of H17 state inference and H04 horizon disagreement

title: E_PROCESS_ANYTIME_VALID_PROMOTION_ABSTENTION_GATE
information_set: Sequential loss differences of a candidate strategy versus frozen baseline
transformation: E-values; test martingales; or e-processes with prespecified betting function
target: Promote; continue; demote; or abstain from a research strategy
temporal_rule: Update after each realized draw; optional stopping allowed only under the specified e-process
selection_or_gating: Promotion requires threshold crossing and safety diagnostics; no score reuse for tuning
canonical_definition: Use an anytime-valid evidence process over prequential loss differences to control when a hypothesis is promoted or suspended
novelty_basis: Extends nested-null and prospective confirmation with optional-stopping-safe action

title: BOCPD_RUN_LENGTH_GATE
information_set: Causal draw or residual stream
transformation: Bayesian online changepoint posterior and run-length distribution
target: Regime allocation or reset
temporal_rule: Posterior updated only with observations through t-1
selection_or_gating: Gate on frozen posterior-probability thresholds
canonical_definition: Use BOCPD run-length probabilities as the changepoint signal for strategy allocation
novelty_basis: Specific implementation already contained by H19

title: DES_LOCAL_COMPETENCE_SELECTOR
information_set: Frozen base-strategy out-of-fold residuals and current covariates
transformation: Neighborhood competence estimation
target: Select one or more existing strategies
temporal_rule: Neighborhood and competence definitions fit within training folds
selection_or_gating: Select only when local support exceeds threshold
canonical_definition: Apply dynamic ensemble selection to frozen strategy predictions
novelty_basis: Local-competence selection is a subcase of H01/H03

title: DPP_DIVERSITY_PORTFOLIO_ALONE
information_set: Ticket quality scores and pairwise similarity
transformation: Determinantal point process
target: Diverse multi-ticket portfolio
temporal_rule: Kernel fit causally
selection_or_gating: Sample or maximize a DPP objective
canonical_definition: Use a DPP or submodular diversity objective to select tickets
novelty_basis: Exact semantic collision with H14

title: STATIC_LOTTERY_NEURAL_MARKOV_ENSEMBLE
information_set: Historical draw indicators and handcrafted frequency features
transformation: Static LSTM; Transformer; Markov; boosting; or voting ensemble
target: Next-draw ticket or number ranking
temporal_rule: Repository-defined historical split; often unclear
selection_or_gating: Always emit a prediction
canonical_definition: Combine common neural; Markov; and frequency predictors without a new causal gate or target
novelty_basis: Components and generic stacking are already represented

title: CONFORMAL_CALIBRATION_ALONE
information_set: Out-of-fold point predictions and calibration residuals
transformation: Conformal calibration
target: Coverage or candidate set
temporal_rule: Calibration precedes prediction
selection_or_gating: Return calibrated set
canonical_definition: Apply conformal calibration without a new downstream decision rule
novelty_basis: Contained by calibrated probability and uncertainty hypotheses

title: TENSOR_DECOMPOSITION_OF_PAIR_TRIPLE_COOCCURRENCE
information_set: Historical pair or triple incidence tensor
transformation: CP or Tucker factorization
target: Pair/triple score
temporal_rule: Causal expanding window
selection_or_gating: Rank combinations by factor score
canonical_definition: Factor a number co-occurrence tensor to score pairs or triples
novelty_basis: A particular higher-order transformation contained by H11/H12 unless linked to a new target

title: TS2VEC_CAUSAL_RESIDUAL_EMBEDDING
information_set: Causal multichannel draw and frozen-strategy residual sequences
transformation: Self-supervised hierarchical contrastive temporal encoding
target: Residual prediction; analogue retrieval; or strategy allocation
temporal_rule: Training windows and augmentations contain no future context; inference uses causal sliding mode
selection_or_gating: Use a simple frozen downstream head and compare against raw lag features
canonical_definition: Learn causal self-supervised embeddings of residual sequences before applying a low-capacity downstream allocator
novelty_basis: Representation-learning objective is new even though neural predictors exist

title: STATIONARY_VINE_COPULA_RESIDUAL_DEPENDENCE
information_set: Calibrated marginal residuals for numbers or strategy families
transformation: Regularized stationary vine-copula decomposition
target: Joint tail-state score; portfolio dependence; or conditional allocation
temporal_rule: Marginals and vine structure fit only on prior out-of-fold residuals
selection_or_gating: Retain only stable edges and compare with pairwise-correlation controls
canonical_definition: Model residual dependence after marginal calibration with a stationary vine and test whether joint tail states add conditional information
novelty_basis: Copula separation of marginals and higher-order dependence is absent from the 28

title: SPARSE_SUBSET_SCAN_CONDITIONAL_EDGE_GATE
information_set: Causal standardized residuals across numbers; strategies; or predeclared groups
transformation: Penalized scan statistic or higher-criticism-style aggregation
target: Detect sparse coordinated edge and choose a fixed allocation or abstention action
temporal_rule: Subsets; penalties; and alarm thresholds calibrated only on earlier null windows
selection_or_gating: Act only after replicated alarms with minimum duration; no post hoc subgroup naming
canonical_definition: Scan for sparse coordinated deviations that vanish in global averages and use alarms as a causal conditional-effect gate
novelty_basis: New sparse-cross-sectional target and aggregation rule
